name: OpenKilda
description: An open-source OpenFlow controller designed for global networks with high control-plane latency. Built by Telstra, handles up to 10,000 switches with 16 million flows. Based on Floodlight with Kafka and Storm.

docker_support.docker_evidence: Run docker-compose up from the base OpenKilda directory. Includes Zookeeper, Kafka, OrientDB, Storm, northbound, southbound, WFM, Floodlight. Supports blue-green deployment.

eval_notes: Production-grade SDN controller used by Telstra in real networks. Complex docker-compose with many microservices. Good for testing large-scale SDN management, L2 services, flow mirroring, and path pinning scenarios.
